symbols.description: An experimental process that produces a value reasonably attributable to a quantitative property of a phenomenon, body, or substance.
symbols.name: measurement

symbols.description: A value produced by measurement and attributable to a quantitative property of a phenomenon, body, or substance.
symbols.name: measurement value

symbols.description: A property of a phenomenon, body, or substance that is the object of measurement.
symbols.name: quantitative property

symbols.description: A phenomenon whose quantitative property may be the object of measurement.
symbols.name: phenomenon

symbols.description: A body whose quantitative property may be the object of measurement.
symbols.name: body

symbols.description: A substance whose quantitative property may be the object of measurement.
symbols.name: substance

symbols.description: The numerical magnitude associated with a measurand.
symbols.name: numerical magnitude

symbols.description: A reference that gives meaning to the numerical magnitude of a measurand.
symbols.name: reference

symbols.description: An example whose mass is given as 1 kg.
symbols.name: International Prototype Kilogram

symbols.description: The quantitative property of the International Prototype Kilogram used as an example.
symbols.name: mass

symbols.description: A basis for direct or indirect comparison in measurement.
symbols.name: standard

symbols.description: A direct or indirect comparison with a standard involved in measurement.
symbols.name: comparison

symbols.description: A certified 32768 Hz example of a standard used in comparison.
symbols.name: quartz crystal resonator

symbols.description: An example of a standard consisting of 1.079 micromole of methane per mole of air.
symbols.name: primary gas mixture

symbols.description: A constituent specified in the example primary gas mixture.
symbols.name: methane

symbols.description: The reference substance specified in the example primary gas mixture.
symbols.name: air

symbols.description: An instrument capable of producing an indication responsive to a property of interest.
symbols.name: measuring instrument

symbols.description: An output produced by a measuring instrument that is responsive to the property of interest.
symbols.name: indication

symbols.description: A process by which a measuring instrument is related to a relevant standard so that its indications are meaningful in relation to that standard.
symbols.name: calibration

symbols.description: A standard in relation to which calibrated instrument indications are meaningful.
symbols.name: relevant standard

symbols.description: The result of a measurement with which measurement uncertainty is associated.
symbols.name: measurement result

symbols.description: A non-negative parameter associated with a measurement result that characterizes the dispersion of values reasonably attributable to the measurand, based on the information used.
symbols.name: measurement uncertainty

symbols.description: A non-negative parameter used to characterize dispersion in the definition of measurement uncertainty.
symbols.name: parameter

symbols.description: The dispersion of values or quantity values that could reasonably be attributed to a measurand.
symbols.name: dispersion

symbols.description: A value being attributed to a measurand.
symbols.name: quantity value

symbols.description: A measurand whose property of interest can be quantified by a single real number.
symbols.name: scalar measurand

symbols.description: A single real number used to quantify a scalar measurand.
symbols.name: real number

symbols.description: A parameter that may express measurement uncertainty for a scalar measurand and that characterizes dispersion as a standard deviation.
symbols.name: standard deviation

symbols.description: Measurement uncertainty expressed as a standard deviation.
symbols.name: standard measurement uncertainty

symbols.description: A specified multiple of a standard deviation that may express measurement uncertainty.
symbols.name: specified multiple

symbols.description: An interval that may include the measurand with a stated coverage probability; its half-width may express measurement uncertainty.
symbols.name: interval

symbols.description: The half-width of an interval that may express measurement uncertainty.
symbols.name: half-width

symbols.description: A stated probability that an interval includes the measurand.
symbols.name: coverage probability

symbols.description: The state of incomplete knowledge about the measurand expressed by measurement uncertainty.
symbols.name: incomplete knowledge

symbols.description: A probability distribution over the set of possible values for a measurand used to represent the corresponding state of knowledge.
symbols.name: probability distribution

symbols.description: A possible value for a measurand over which a probability distribution is defined.
symbols.name: possible value

symbols.description: The state of knowledge about a measurand represented by a probability distribution.
symbols.name: state of knowledge

symbols.description: The scatter of a probability distribution over the range of possible values.
symbols.name: scatter

symbols.description: The range over which a probability distribution representing knowledge about a measurand scatters.
symbols.name: range of possible values
